name: Aargau
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Aargau
summary: Divided vertically: black with a white wavy band at the hoist, and blue with three white stars at the fly.
origin: Aargau was formed in 1803 under the Act of Mediation. Its arms were designed at that time.

symbols.name: Wavy band
symbols.description: A white wavy line on black.

symbols.name: Three stars
symbols.meaning: The three districts united to form the canton.

facts: Its name means 'land of the Aare'.
clues: Black with a wavy white line beside blue with three stars.
Its wavy line is the river that names the canton.
